description: Spec 011 FR-001, FR-002: the frozen C on tuning seed 323 (150 sigma = 1 deg scenarios) under no mismatch, each kind alone at central severity and all four. Two runs per condition on the same rows: C as frozen, and C with the true change starts added as nominations (confirmation still decides), which separates a nomination failure from a confirmation failure. Plain final solve, 12 knots.
